register_new_user: register a new user by posting username, password, and email to the Action Engine API
create_api_key: create an API key for a user by posting credentials to the auth api-keys endpoint
run_register_command: run the interactive registration command that prompts for username, email, password, and saves credentials
validate_email: validate an email address by checking for an @ symbol and a dot in the domain
review_register_command: review the register_command function to understand the interactive user registration and credential saving flow
